intro.title: Set your numbers, then build the week.
intro.body: GainPlan works out your calorie and macro targets, fills seven days with high-protein meals scaled to hit them, batches what can be batched, and turns the whole thing into one shopping list sorted the way you walk {{store}}.

region.title: Where you shop
region.hint: Picks the food, recipes, stores, currency and language.

chain.title: Store
chain.hint: Which shop the list is for, and where its items link.

food.title: Food
food.hint: How the day is split up, and what stays off the menu.

measurements.title: Measurements
measurements.hint: What the calorie calculation runs on.
measurements.sexHint: Only used by the BMR formula.

activity.label: Activity
activity.hint: Everything outside the gym — job, steps, daily life.

goal.title: Goal
goal.hint: Sets the calorie offset from maintenance.

cycling.label: Calorie cycling
cycling.hintDefault: More carbs on training days, fewer on rest days. Same weekly total.
cycling.hintDetail: {{training}} kcal on training days, {{rest}} on rest days.

macroSplit.title: Macro split
macroSplit.hint: Protein is fixed per kg; carbs take whatever is left.
macroSplit.proteinHint: 1.6-2.2 g/kg covers the evidence for muscle gain. Higher end when cutting.
macroSplit.fatHint: Below 20% starts to cost you hormones and satiety.
macroSplit.manualHint: Leave empty to use the calculated target.

meals.title: Meal structure
meals.hint: How the day's calories get divided up.

diet.title: What you will not eat
diet.hint: Recipes containing these are never suggested.

kitchen.title: How you cook
kitchen.hint: Filters the recipe pool and plans your batches.
kitchen.maxTimeHint: Recipes that take longer are dropped from the pool.
kitchen.leftoversHint: Turns batch-friendly dinners into the next day's lunch.

cookingFor.title: Cooking for
cookingFor.hint: Scales shopping and batch quantities. Your macros never change.

weighIn.title: Weigh-in
weighIn.hint: Morning, after the toilet, before food. The trend is what matters, not any single number.
weighIn.empty: Log four or more days and this will tell you whether to move your calorie target, and by how much.

trend.cutSlow: — losing slower than a cut needs. Drop the target by ~150 kcal.
trend.cutFast: — dropping fast enough to cost you muscle. Add ~200 kcal.
trend.cutGood: — that is the right rate for a cut. Leave the target alone.
trend.bulkNone: — not gaining. Add ~200 kcal and check again in two weeks.
trend.bulkFast: — gaining fast enough that much of it is fat. Trim ~150 kcal.
trend.bulkGood: — a good gaining rate. Hold here.

poolWarning_one: Only {{count}} recipe matches your restrictions and time limit. The week will repeat itself — loosen something if you want variety.
poolWarning_other: Only {{count}} recipes match your restrictions and time limit. The week will repeat itself — loosen something if you want variety.
resetConfirm: Erase your profile, plan and weigh-ins from this browser?
